title: English Practice Quiz 0874
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A 'courtesy' call is made as a gesture of:
questions.explanation: Courtesy refers to politeness and consideration.

questions.question: A 'refund' is:
questions.explanation: A refund is repayment of money.

questions.question: A 'query' is another word for:
questions.explanation: Query means a question or request for information.

questions.question: A customer asks for an 'estimate'. They want:
questions.explanation: An estimate is an approximate calculation or quotation.

questions.question: A 'queue' is a line of people waiting for:
questions.explanation: A queue is a line of people waiting.

questions.question: To 'acknowledge' a request means to:
options: confirm that it has been received or noticed
questions.explanation: Acknowledge means recognise or confirm receipt.

questions.question: A 'complaint reference number' helps to:
questions.explanation: A reference number identifies a case for follow-up.

questions.question: A 'walk-in customer' is someone who:
questions.explanation: Walk-in customers arrive without a prior booking.

questions.question: A 'service outage' means:
questions.explanation: An outage is a period when a service is not operating.
